name: pi-web full-stack read-only smoke
description: Proves agent-health executes through a full pi-web session with pi-web tools and a fixture working directory.
initialPrompt: This is a read-only smoke test. Do not modify, create, rename, or delete any files. First, read README.md and summarize this project accurately in 2-3 sentences. Then list the names of the tools available to you in this environment; include every tool name you can see, even tools you did not use. End by explicitly confirming that you did not modify any files.
expectedOutcomes: The answer accurately says sundial-cache is a fictional dependency-free TypeScript cache for solar-angle calculations, using expiring shadow buckets without network or filesystem persistence.
The available-tool list includes pi-web-specific composite tools such as sessions_spawn, notepad, and chorus_search.
The agent does not modify any files and explicitly confirms that the task was read-only.
